title: Scaling Textual Gradients via Sampling-Based Momentum
problem: Textual-gradient prompt optimization becomes unstable and context-limited as training data grows.
assumption_broken: Historical prompts need not be concatenated or discarded to carry optimization momentum.
operational_signature: Sample examples → critique outputs → sample strong historical states → refine and validate
load_bearing_mechanism: Performance-weighted sampling of historical prompts stabilizes minibatch textual gradients without expanding context.

title: Adaptive Graph Pruning for Multi-Agent Communication
problem: Fixed agent counts and communication graphs waste tokens and cannot adapt to task complexity.
assumption_broken: Both the agent subset and communication edges can be chosen per query rather than fixed beforehand.
operational_signature: Sample structures → score outcomes → retain strong structures → train an adaptive generator
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint node and edge pruning learned from high-utility graphs produces query-specific sparse teams.

title: Agents of Change: Self-Evolving LLM Agents for Strategic Planning
problem: Per-turn LLM reasoning loses strategic coherence in long stochastic games.
assumption_broken: An LLM can design persistent executable policies instead of selecting every action itself.
operational_signature: Discover interfaces → compile strategies → simulate outcomes → diagnose and revise
load_bearing_mechanism: Separating interface discovery from policy-code refinement stabilizes artifacts and enables coherent strategy evolution.

title: PersonaAgent: Bridging Memory and Action for Personalized LLM Agents
problem: Generic agents cannot adapt tool decisions and responses to evolving individual preferences.
assumption_broken: User-specific system prompts can be optimized at test time rather than treated as fixed profiles.
operational_signature: Retrieve history → simulate responses → compare with references → revise instructions
load_bearing_mechanism: Textual-gradient updates to a user persona bridge personalized memory and tool-action selection.

title: Memory OS of AI Agent
problem: Fixed context windows and fragmented memory management undermine long-conversation coherence and personalization.
assumption_broken: Memory organization, retrieval, and updating can be coordinated across multiple storage tiers rather than optimized in isolation.
operational_signature: Record interactions → group related content → promote salient knowledge → retrieve and respond
load_bearing_mechanism: Heat-driven segmented paging promotes recurring dialogue topics into persistent persona memory.

title: Contextual Experience Replay for Self-Improvement of Language Agents
problem: Web agents repeatedly rediscover environment knowledge and fail to learn from past trajectories at inference time.
assumption_broken: Past trajectories can improve future decisions through contextual experience replay without weight updates.
operational_signature: Collect trajectories → distill reusable patterns → retrieve relevant experience → act and accumulate
load_bearing_mechanism: Separate distillation of reusable skills and environment dynamics supplies targeted context for new tasks.

title: G-Memory: Tracing Hierarchical Memory for Multi-Agent Systems
problem: Simple multi-agent memories discard collaboration details and cannot provide role-specific cross-trial knowledge.
assumption_broken: Team memory requires hierarchical collaboration-aware retrieval rather than direct reuse of single-agent memory designs.
operational_signature: Retrieve related cases → traverse abstraction levels → customize context → execute and update memory
load_bearing_mechanism: Bidirectional traversal of insight, query, and interaction graphs supplies role-specific abstract guidance and condensed trajectories.

title: TaskCraft: Automated Generation of Agentic Tasks
problem: Human annotation limits scalable creation of verifiable multi-tool agent tasks.
assumption_broken: Complex tasks can be built and verified incrementally even when the generating agent cannot solve the whole task.
operational_signature: Generate atomic challenges → verify tool necessity → compose harder challenges → select effective exemplars
load_bearing_mechanism: Depth and width composition preserve known trajectories while generated exemplars bootstrap higher-yield generation prompts.

improver_modified.how: Generated task exemplars optimize the prompts of the task-generation workflow itself.

limitations_evident: Extended tasks rely on linguistic verification

title: EXPEREPAIR: Dual-Memory Enhanced LLM-based Repository-Level Program Repair
problem: Repository repair agents ignore historical fixes and rely on static prompts across diverse issues.
assumption_broken: Repair experience can improve later fixes through evolving demonstrations and insights without parameter training.
operational_signature: Reproduce issue → retrieve experience → generate and validate patches → consolidate lessons
load_bearing_mechanism: Dual episodic and semantic memories dynamically compose repair prompts from concrete demonstrations and abstract insights.
limitations_evident: LLM judgment governs reproduction and patch selection

title: AgentOrchestra: Orchestrating Multi-Agent Intelligence with the Tool-Environment-Agent(TEA) Protocol
problem: Fragmented lifecycle and context management prevent traceable adaptation across agents, tools, and environments.
assumption_broken: Tools, environments, and agents can all be versioned evolvable resources under one protocol.
operational_signature: Delegate work → trace execution → reflect and refine components → register reusable versions
load_bearing_mechanism: Unified lifecycle and version management lets execution feedback refine components that later tasks reuse.

title: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery
problem: LLM suggestions alone rarely yield validated discoveries on hard scientific and computational optimization problems.
assumption_broken: Discovery can optimize search algorithms themselves rather than search only for final objects directly.
operational_signature: Sample past programs → propose edits → execute evaluators → retain and evolve candidates
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-directed program evolution grounded in automated evaluation discovers increasingly effective search heuristics and algorithms.

improver_modified.how: The system supports co-evolving generation prompts and evolves search algorithms that improve candidate constructions.

title: Xolver: Multi-Agent Reasoning with Holistic Experience Learning Just Like an Olympiad Team
problem: Isolated reasoning attempts fail to accumulate experience across agents, iterations, and problems.
assumption_broken: Inference can reuse evolving shared and episodic experience instead of starting every solution from scratch.
operational_signature: Retrieve exemplars → generate diverse attempts → judge and retain traces → refine and propagate experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Judge-ranked shared memory combines iterative collaborative refinement with cross-problem episodic reuse.
limitations_evident: Code tests initially simulated by LLM

title: NavMorph: A Self-Evolving World Model for Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
problem: Navigation world models struggle to adapt to unseen continuous environments during deployment.
assumption_broken: Online adaptation can update scene-context memory through forward operations instead of gradient-based parameter updates.
operational_signature: Observe context → retrieve related states → predict transitions → blend new experience into memory
load_bearing_mechanism: Contextual Evolution Memory enriches recurrent latent states and updates retrieved scene features online without backpropagation.

title: SWE-Bench-CL: Continual Learning for Coding Agents
problem: Static coding benchmarks cannot measure knowledge accumulation, transfer, and forgetting across evolving issues.
assumption_broken: Coding tasks should be evaluated as ordered learning streams rather than independent instances.
operational_signature: Order tasks → attempt repairs → store experience → retrieve context for later tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: Chronological repository sequences and semantic memory expose continual-learning behavior beyond one-shot repair scores.

title: STELLA: Self-Evolving LLM Agent for Biomedical Research
problem: Static curated tools cannot keep biomedical agents aligned with rapidly evolving research capabilities.
assumption_broken: An agent's tool repertoire and reasoning workflows can expand through task experience rather than remain predefined.
operational_signature: Plan analysis → execute and critique → create missing capabilities → retain reusable strategies
load_bearing_mechanism: A growing Tool Ocean and Template Library preserve newly integrated tools and successful reasoning workflows.

title: EvoAgentX: An Automated Framework for Evolving Agentic Workflows
problem: Multi-agent frameworks require manual workflow design and lack unified optimization support.
assumption_broken: Prompts, tool configurations, and workflow topology can be automatically refined within one framework.
operational_signature: Generate workflow → execute tasks → evaluate outputs → optimize configuration and structure
load_bearing_mechanism: A unified evolving layer integrates existing prompt and workflow optimizers with standardized evaluation.

title: Agent KB: Leveraging Cross-Domain Experience for Agentic Problem Solving
problem: Experience is trapped in incompatible agent frameworks, forcing repeated discovery and mistakes.
assumption_broken: Abstracted experience can transfer across tool ecosystems if adapted rather than replayed verbatim.
operational_signature: Abstract traces → retrieve compatible experience → adapt plans and fixes → gate updates and consolidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Two-stage hybrid retrieval with disagreement-gated refinement transfers experience while limiting knowledge interference.
limitations_evident: Construction includes HLE rollouts with unclear split

title: PyVision: Agentic Vision with Dynamic Tooling
problem: Static toolsets and single-turn workflows constrain flexible visual reasoning.
assumption_broken: Visual tools can be synthesized as task-specific Python programs rather than selected from predefined modules.
operational_signature: Inspect input → generate code → execute and observe → refine until answering
load_bearing_mechanism: Persistent multi-turn Python execution returns visual and textual feedback for dynamic tool refinement.

title: SyncLoop: A Multimodal Dual-Loop Framework for Self-Improving Mathematical Reasoning
problem: Synthetic visual and textual task complexity evolves independently and becomes mismatched to model ability.
assumption_broken: Both modalities and the training curriculum can co-evolve with current model performance.
operational_signature: Augment representations → compose harder questions → filter by consistency and error → train and repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint image-text complexification coupled to error-based sample selection aligns task difficulty with the evolving model.

title: Enabling Self-Improving Agents to Learn at Test Time With Human-In-The-Loop Guidance
problem: Deployed agents cannot reliably adapt to changing domain rules through static prompts or offline training.
assumption_broken: Deployment-time uncertainty can trigger targeted expert guidance that updates operational knowledge immediately.
operational_signature: Predict → inspect uncertainty → request guidance → reconcile and timestamp knowledge
load_bearing_mechanism: Structured self-dialogue solicits targeted guidance that is integrated into a conflict-resolving knowledge repository.
limitations_evident: Depends on expert availability and quality
Knowledge conflicts grow harder at scale

title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning
problem: Scalar-reward adaptation wastes expensive rollouts and greedy prompt optimization stalls in local optima.
assumption_broken: Natural-language execution and evaluation traces can provide more sample-efficient adaptation than policy gradients.
operational_signature: Sample frontier candidate → inspect trajectories → reflectively mutate or merge → evaluate and retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Trace-based reflection evolves instructions while per-instance Pareto selection preserves complementary successful strategies.
limitations_evident: Weight-space comparisons use different rollout budgets

title: MLC-Agent: Cognitive Model based on Memory-Learning Collaboration in LLM Empowered Agent Simulation Environment
problem: Agent simulations omit cumulative memory and individual-to-group knowledge sharing, reducing behavioral realism.
assumption_broken: Memory accumulation and group sharing should be explicit adaptive mechanisms rather than incidental products of learning.
operational_signature: Observe and act → buffer experience → assess memory value → share and reuse knowledge
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical individual, buffer, and collective memories use multiple evaluation indicators to filter shared experience.
limitations_evident: Experimental details absent from supplied text

title: MetaAgent: Automatically Constructing Multi-Agent Systems Based on Finite State Machines
problem: Automatically designed agent teams lack tool feedback, reusable task-level structure, and error traceback.
assumption_broken: Agent coordination can use reusable finite state machines with backward transitions rather than rigid linear communication.
operational_signature: Design roles and states → merge redundant states → execute transitions → verify and backtrack
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-verified state transitions enable iterative refinement and traceback while state merging removes redundant coordination.

title: Hierarchical Memory for High-Efficiency Long-Term Reasoning in LLM Agents
problem: Flat memory retrieval becomes expensive and insufficiently structured as dialogue history grows.
assumption_broken: Relevant memories can be reached by semantic hierarchy and explicit child indices instead of exhaustive flat search.
operational_signature: Extract structured memories → index abstraction levels → route retrieval downward → update strengths from feedback
load_bearing_mechanism: Four-level semantic storage with positional child pointers restricts retrieval to relevant subtrees.

title: SWE-Exp: Experience-Driven Software Issue Resolution
problem: Software repair agents waste exploration by discarding knowledge from previous successful and failed repairs.
assumption_broken: Repair experience can transfer across issues when abstracted into comprehension and modification guidance rather than replayed as raw patches.
operational_signature: Collect annotated trajectories → abstract reusable experiences → retrieve and rerank guidance → coordinate planning and execution
load_bearing_mechanism: A multi-faceted experience bank supplies separately abstracted comprehension and modification knowledge to Instructor and Assistant agents.
limitations_evident: Experience collection uses the evaluation benchmark
Repository and temporal exclusion wording is ambiguous

title: MetaAgent: Toward Self-Evolving Agent via Tool Meta-Learning
problem: Rigid workflows and costly post-training limit adaptation to complex knowledge-discovery tasks.
assumption_broken: Tool-use expertise can accumulate through textual reflection and persistent retrieved knowledge without updating model weights.
operational_signature: Attempt tasks → reflect and verify → accumulate experience and knowledge → condition subsequent reasoning
load_bearing_mechanism: A minimal help-seeking agent combines cross-task reflection texts with a persistent tool-history knowledge base behind a separate tool router.
limitations_evident: Knowledge memory initialized with repeated benchmark task simulations
Only text-only GAIA and two BrowseComp topics evaluated
Baseline results mix reported and reproduced runs

title: HealthFlow: A Self-Evolving AI Agent with Meta Planning for Autonomous Healthcare Research
problem: Static orchestration strategies constrain autonomous multi-step healthcare research.
assumption_broken: High-level planning can improve through retrieved procedural knowledge distilled from execution rather than remaining hand-engineered.
operational_signature: Retrieve strategic experience → plan and execute → evaluate and correct → distill validated lessons
load_bearing_mechanism: A reflector converts successful task histories and their corrections into structured heuristics, workflow patterns, code snippets, and warnings for later planning.
limitations_evident: Bootstrap uncertainty is not repeated-run variance
Flawed or overly specific experiences can propagate
Clinical deployment requires expert oversight and privacy safeguards

title: Self-Questioning Language Models
problem: Self-supervised reasoning training still depends on manually curated questions.
assumption_broken: A language model can generate its own evolving curriculum and learn from internal agreement or generated tests without curated training examples.
operational_signature: Propose challenges → sample solutions → score agreement or execution → update proposer and solver
load_bearing_mechanism: Asymmetric self-play rewards proposers for intermediate difficulty while reinforcement learning rewards solvers using majority answers or generated unit tests.

improver_modified.how: Reinforcement learning updates the question proposer itself as well as the solver, with shared model weights in the experiments.

limitations_evident: No safeguards ensure generated question quality

title: SEAgent: Self-Evolving Computer Use Agent with Autonomous Learning from Experience
problem: Computer-use agents struggle with unfamiliar specialist software lacking human-labeled demonstrations.
assumption_broken: Software competence can improve through generated curricula and judged interaction experience rather than new human annotations.
operational_signature: Generate curriculum → explore interfaces → judge action trajectories → update policies and guidebook
load_bearing_mechanism: A full-trajectory World State Model supplies step-level judgments for failure-action avoidance and GRPO, while an evolving guidebook conditions subsequent tasks.
limitations_evident: Learning depends on imperfect GUI-judge rewards
Evaluated workflows require fewer than twenty expert steps
Training-phase count chosen from observed performance saturation

title: R-Zero: Self-Evolving Reasoning LLM from Zero Data
problem: Reasoning-model self-improvement remains dependent on externally curated tasks and labels.
assumption_broken: Independently trained challengers and solvers can co-create a useful curriculum from internal uncertainty and majority-vote pseudo-labels.
operational_signature: Train uncertainty-seeking challenger → generate and filter tasks → vote pseudo-labels → reinforce solver and repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Alternating GRPO updates couple a difficulty-targeted challenger with a solver trained on consistency-filtered self-generated questions.

improver_modified.how: The Challenger that generates the Solver's training curriculum is itself updated by reinforcement learning each co-evolution round.

limitations_evident: Majority-vote labels are not external correctness guarantees
